title: Mindfulness
summary: Notice thoughts, feelings, sensations, and surroundings without needing to fix them.
practice: Pause and name one thing you notice in your body, mind, and environment.

title: Emotional Data
summary: Emotions can be useful information about needs, values, and conditions.
practice: Name the emotion, where you feel it, and one gentle need it may point toward.

title: Safety & Perception
summary: A sense of safety shapes what the nervous system notices and how it responds.
practice: Orient to the room: slowly notice five neutral or supportive details.

title: Baselines
summary: Patterns become clearer when you know what is typical for you.
practice: Record a simple baseline: energy, tension, focus, and connection today.

title: Your Zone
summary: Your workable zone can widen through awareness, support, and pacing.
practice: Choose one small action that helps you return toward a workable zone.

title: Grounding
summary: Grounding brings attention back to the present when things feel too much or too far away.
practice: Try a sensory grounding practice and keep only what feels useful.

title: Current Conditions
summary: Current conditions include the body, environment, relationships, and demands around you.
practice: Map one current condition that supports you and one that adds pressure.

title: Background
summary: Earlier experiences can become background influences without defining the whole person.
practice: Notice a familiar pattern with curiosity; you do not need to analyze it deeply.

title: Triggers
summary: Triggers are signals that a situation has become activating, not a personal failure.
practice: Identify one early cue and one grounding choice for when it appears.

title: Survival Strategies
summary: Strategies that once protected you may still show up; appreciation can come before change.
practice: Thank a protective strategy, then consider one safer present-day option.

title: Vision & Values
summary: Values can offer direction when the next step is uncertain.
practice: Choose one value and one small action that expresses it this week.

title: Self-Talk & Beliefs
summary: Inner language can be noticed, questioned, and made more supportive.
practice: Rewrite one harsh thought into language that is honest and kind.

title: Attachment & Communication
summary: Connection patterns can be explored with curiosity, clarity, and consent.
practice: Practice a simple “I notice / I need” statement privately or with support.

title: Relationships & Boundaries
summary: Boundaries clarify what supports respect, safety, and connection.
practice: Draft one brief boundary that fits your current situation.

title: SMART Goals
summary: Specific, realistic goals can turn values into a next move.
practice: Make one goal specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound.
